hook: Your rocket booster just got caught by giant metal arms.
title: A Giant Rocket Was Caught By Metal Arms
description:
In October 2024, SpaceX's Super Heavy booster returned to its launch tower and was caught mid-air by the arms nicknamed the chopsticks. It had no landing legs. Series: Wait, What? Space.

#Shorts #SpaceX #Starship
